name: dependabot-review
description: Use when the user asks to "review dependabot PR", "review this bump", "audit deps", "check this bump", or invokes /dependabot-review. Read-only analyst for dependabot/Renovate PRs that only touch package.json / pnpm-lock.yaml / poetry.lock. Surfaces blockers, smoke-test scopes, and adoption opportunities across four passes (enumerate, usage, lockfile-only, API delta). Makes no approval decisions and writes nothing — output is a report for the user.
